name: Explosive Entrance
description: An alchemical bombs explodes when the rubble is shifted, filling the hall with flame.
disable: DC 30 Crafting (master) to nullify the bomb's alchemical components or DC 28 Thievery (master) to disable the bomb

defensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature in contact with the ground travels down this hall

Effect The bombs explodes, dealing (6d8+12) Fire Damage damage to the triggering creature and all creatures within 20 feet (Basic DC 32 Reflex Saving Throw save). Additionally, if the triggering creature fails their saving throw, they take 1d8 Persistent,fire Damage damage.
